verdict.rationale: There is a confirmed official CLI (rippling-cli) with Flux commands for creating, managing, and deploying Rippling-hosted integrations, but evidence is limited to a single GitHub reference and lacks depth on installation, command breadth, or AI-native workflow support (e.g., scripting, agent integration). missing for 10: broader documentation of CLI capabilities, independent hands-on validation, explicit AI-native/agentic use-case support.
